# POKéMON Simulator in the browser

This repository holds only the browser build of [POKéMON Simulator](https://github.com/jsperandio/pokemon-simulator), played at **https://jsperandio.github.io/pokemon-simulator-web/**. Each folder is a release's web archive, unpacked as it is. The source code, the releases and the issues are in [jsperandio/pokemon-simulator](https://github.com/jsperandio/pokemon-simulator).

## Versions

Each link opens that version's game:

| Version | | What it is | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| [v4.5.0](https://jsperandio.github.io/pokemon-simulator-web/v4.5.0/) | Original | the 2004 game, as Michael Madsen made it | [release notes](https://github.com/jsperandio/pokemon-simulator/releases/tag/v4.5.0) · [BirdieSoft's page](https://birdiesoft.dk/software.php?id=2) |

The game keeps its files in the browser's storage, where they stay between visits. The original keeps its saves apart from the later versions; to carry a save over, use Download in one version's file dialog and Upload in the other's.
